research_question: How do CMIP6 models represent the historical and projected 21st-century decline of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) under various emission scenarios?

phase_1.user_prompt: We are analyzing the projected 21st-century decline of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) in CMIP6. We evaluate AMOC strength across a reference run for the observed past, the Tier-1 scenario projections spanning low to high-end radiative forcing, an abrupt quadrupled-CO2 experiment, and single-forcing runs isolating greenhouse gases and aerosols. Which CMIP6 experiments and which overturning streamfunction variables do we need?

phase_2.user_prompt: Using the models, experiments, and stream function variables we just identified, please write the code to query and retrieve this data from the CMIP6 archive. We need to fetch the datasets for the 27 specified models across the historical, scenario (SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, SSP3-7.0, SSP5-8.5), abrupt 4xCO2, and single-forcing historical experiments.
